reason: Agora EU Gas Exit Pathway publishes net GHG for 2018, 2030, 2040 and 2050 only (Breaking free from fossil gas, 2023, Annex 1 Table 1, p. 64); no 2015 or 2020 value exists, so the 2030/2040 cuts are harmonised on 2018, scaled to the EEA inventory 2018 (3,493.5 Mt). Approved by the Secretariat in session 24 Nov 2026. [human review 2026-11]

Agora reports industry emissions (797 Mt CO2e in 2018, 36 Mt in 2050; Annex 1 Table 1, row Industry, one GHG total without energy/process split) with 2018 as its start year instead of 2020. The "industry data reported" rule is meant to require industry data, which are reported; 2018 is accepted as the start year. Approved by the Secretariat in session 24 Nov 2026. [human review 2026-11]

Compass Lexecon for BusinessEurope (July 2024) publishes EU27 net GHG for 2019 (3,337 Mt, historical), 2040 and 2050 only (p. 43 chart labels); no 2015 or 2020 value, so the cuts are harmonised on 2019, scaled to the EEA inventory 2019. Same mechanism as Agora (pso-entries for ID 2000). The industry rule is not waived: no industry series is published, so the pathway stops at "no industry data". Added on the Secretariat instruction to add every available source, 25 Nov 2026. [human review 2026-11]

Rodrigues et al. (2026) contributes 337 REMIND-EU runs, 336 of them sensitivities of one set-up; screening all of them put 155 of the 160 ECL members in one study. The Secretariat decided to use one run only: the paper's reference scenario 14_Nzero_57_bio7p5 (Table 1 footnote: 57 % by 2030, reference final energy, biomass 7.5 EJ/yr, default CCS, hydrogen, synthetic fuels and VRE). The other 336 runs stay in additions/rodrigues2026_*.csv; delete this entry to screen them again. Decided by the Secretariat in session, 25 Nov 2026. [human review 2026-11]
